\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows,positioning}

\makeatletter
\pgfarrowsdeclare{signal leaf}{signal leaf}{
  \pgfutil@tempdima=.8pt
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdima by.25\pgflinewidth
  \pgfarrowsleftextend{-2.2\pgfutil@tempdima}
  \pgfarrowsrightextend{3.2\pgfutil@tempdima}
  \pgfarrowshullpoint{3.4\pgfutil@tempdima\advance\pgf@x by.5\pgflinewidth}{0pt}
  \pgfarrowsupperhullpoint{-2.3\pgfutil@tempdima}{2.7\pgfutil@tempdima\advance\pgf@y by.5\pgflinewidth}
}{
  \pgfutil@tempdima=.8pt
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdima by.25\pgflinewidth
  \pgfsetroundjoin
  \pgfpathmoveto{\pgfqpoint{3.2\pgfutil@tempdima}{0pt}}
  \pgfpathcurveto
    {\pgfqpoint{2\pgfutil@tempdima}{2.6\pgfutil@tempdima}}
    {\pgfqpoint{-.4\pgfutil@tempdima}{2.4\pgfutil@tempdima}}
    {\pgfqpoint{-2.2\pgfutil@tempdima}{0pt}}
  \pgfpathcurveto
    {\pgfqpoint{-.4\pgfutil@tempdima}{-2.4\pgfutil@tempdima}}
    {\pgfqpoint{2\pgfutil@tempdima}{-2.6\pgfutil@tempdima}}
    {\pgfqpoint{3.2\pgfutil@tempdima}{0pt}}
  \pgfpathclose
  \pgfusepathqfillstroke
}
\pgfarrowsdeclarealias{telemetry}{telemetry}{signal leaf}{signal leaf}
\pgfarrowsdeclarereversed{telemetry reversed}{telemetry reversed}{signal leaf}{signal leaf}
\makeatother

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  box/.style={draw,rounded corners=2pt,minimum width=22mm,minimum height=9mm,align=center},
  node distance=18mm and 22mm
]
  \draw[blue!75!black,line width=1.6pt,-{telemetry}] (-.3,2.5) -- (7.9,2.5)
    node[midway,below=2pt] {Telemetry bus};

  \node[box,fill=blue!8] (sensor) at (0,0) {Sensor};
  \node[box,fill=green!10,right=of sensor] (controller) {Controller};
  \node[box,fill=orange!12,right=of controller] (actuator) {Actuator};

  \draw[blue!75!black,very thick,-{telemetry}] (sensor) -- node[above]{sample} (controller);
  \draw[orange!85!black,thick,-{telemetry reversed}] (controller) -- node[above]{command} (actuator);
  \draw[green!50!black,thick,{telemetry reversed}-{telemetry}]
    (sensor.south) |- ([yshift=-12mm]actuator.south) -| (actuator.south)
    node[pos=.5,below=2pt] {feedback};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
